nodes.text: Obtain mass spectrometry spectra to determine molecular weight
Mass spectrum shows molecular ion peak at m/z 182.073 (intensity 100)
Molecular weight is approximately 182 based on mass spectrum

support.quote: The mass spectrometry data indicates a molecular ion peak at m/z 182.073, which suggests the molecular weight of the compound is approximately 182.

nodes.text: Obtain 13C NMR spectra to gather information about the carbon framework
13C NMR signals suggest aromatic carbons and a carbonyl group, indicating an aromatic ring with a carbonyl

support.quote: The 13C NMR spectra show signals that suggest the presence of aromatic carbons (around 128-137 ppm) and a carbonyl group (around 196 ppm).

nodes.text: Obtain proton NMR spectra to identify hydrogen environments
1H NMR shows a signal at 7.51 ppm (10H) with complex multiplicity
Obtain IR spectra to confirm presence of carbonyl group
10 aromatic protons consistent with a biphenyl structure; combined with carbonyl signal, compound is likely a biphenyl ketone

support.quote: the integration suggests 10 protons, which is consistent with a biphenyl structure. Given the carbonyl signal in the 13C NMR, the compound is likely a biphenyl ketone.

nodes.text: IR spectra shows absorption at 1697 cm-1 and aromatic C-H stretches around 3075-3097 cm-1
IR absorption at 1697 cm-1 confirms carbonyl (C=O stretch), consistent with a ketone

support.quote: The IR spectra show a strong absorption at 1697 cm⁻¹, which is indicative of a carbonyl group (C=O stretch). This supports the presence of a ketone group in the compound.
A plausible structure is benzophenone, which has a molecular weight of 182 and fits the spectral data.
